comparison.objective: Tighten a rack of pool balls and remove the triangle without disturbing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress many free-rolling objects into a tight pack and lift a surrounding frame vertically.
comparison.success_condition: All 30 neighbor pairs within 0.5 mm, head ball within 5 mm of the spot, and no ball displaced over 3 mm during rack removal.
comparison.reason: The record tests collective manipulation of rolling objects and disturbance-free frame removal, absent from damper adjustment and impact-response commissioning.
